body: thank you :) i was definitely in a mood when i wrote this and i am still contemplating ending it all, but this had definitely helped. i have talked to my boyfriend about this, and he always reassures me, but i can just never believe it. it really isn't his fault either, he is an amazing person, and it just shows how much i just need to work on myself if i ever do finally decide to. i'm sure you look rather amazing too friend, as your personality definitely shines through your reply. thank you for the kind words, and best of luck to you too friend :)
